title: Subulate
summary: SUB'ULATE, adjective [Latin subula, an awl.] In botany, shaped like an awl; awl-shaped. A subulate leaf, is linear at the bottom, but gradually tapering towards the end.

inlines.v: SUB'ULATE, adjective [Latin subula, an awl.] In botany, shaped like an awl; awl-shaped. A subulate leaf, is linear at the bottom, but gradually tapering towards the end.
